seoTitle: Cloudflare Logpush Viewer: Cache, Country and Bot Score
metaDescription: Summarise Cloudflare Logpush HTTP request logs: cache status, status codes, countries and bot score bands. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Reads Logpush http_requests NDJSON and shows cache, status, country, bot score bands and edge time to first byte.
why:
Logpush files hold one JSON object per request. A summary by cache status and country answers common questions without a log platform.

Bot score bands follow Cloudflare's description: 1 automated, 2 to 29 likely automated, 30 to 99 likely human. Scores exist only on plans with Bot Management.
howTo: Download Logpush files and paste them or choose them (gzip works).
Switch to the table for rows.
